stories.headline: Arm Unveils AGI CPU — Its First In-House Chip in 35 Years — Backed by Meta and OpenAI

key_facts.fact: Arm's AGI CPU has 136 Neoverse V3 cores per chip, scales to 8,160 cores in an air-cooled 1U server and 45,000 cores in liquid-cooled systems
key_facts.excerpt: 136 Neoverse V3 cores per chip; scales to 8,160 cores in an air-cooled 1U server; 45,000 cores in liquid-cooled systems

key_facts.fact: Meta spearheaded the development; early customers include OpenAI, SK Telecom, and SAP; OEM partners include Lenovo, Supermicro, and Quanta Computer
key_facts.excerpt: Meta spearheaded the development; early customers include OpenAI, SK Telecom, SAP; OEM partners: Lenovo, Supermicro, Quanta Computer

key_facts.fact: The AGI CPU is Arm's first internally designed chip since its founding in 1990, claims >2x performance vs. existing x86 CPUs at lower power
key_facts.excerpt: Arm's first internally designed chip since its founding in 1990; claims >2x performance vs. existing x86 CPUs at lower power

key_facts.fact: Commercialization is targeted for H2 2026; Meta plans to combine the chip with its MTIA accelerator for optimized data center deployments
key_facts.excerpt: Commercialization targeted H2 2026; Meta plans to combine it with its MTIA accelerator for optimized data center use

key_facts.excerpt: TSMC's entire production capacity through 2028 is booked; its planned Fab 4 in Arizona targeted 2030 is also fully reserved despite not yet breaking ground

key_facts.excerpt: Samsung's 2nm yield has improved to over 60% — the threshold for economically viable mass production

key_facts.fact: Samsung has secured orders from Tesla and Apple, with negotiations ongoing with Nvidia, AMD, and Arm for 2nm production
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung has secured orders from Tesla and Apple; negotiations ongoing with Nvidia, AMD, and Arm

key_facts.excerpt: AMD and Meta are conducting on-site audits of Samsung's HBM4 memory production lines, shifting from pledges to validation

key_facts.excerpt: Purchases were completed in both 2025 and 2026, years after US export controls were in place

stories.headline: Swiss Startup Kandou AI Raises $225M From SoftBank and Synopsys to Replace Optical Interconnects With Enhanced Copper

key_facts.fact: Kandou AI raised a $225M Series A — the largest in company history — at a valuation of $400M, led by Maverick Silicon with SoftBank and Synopsys as strategic investors
key_facts.excerpt: Round: $225M Series A — largest in company history; valuation: $400M; lead investor: Maverick Silicon; strategic investors: SoftBank, Synopsys, Cadence Design Systems, Alchip Technologies

key_facts.fact: Kandou's 'chord signalling' technology sends correlated signals across multiple copper wires, doubling to quadrupling bandwidth while halving power consumption, achieving 448+ Gbps
key_facts.excerpt: Technology: 'Chord signalling' — sends correlated signals across multiple copper wires, doubling to quadrupling bandwidth while halving power consumption; achieves 448+ Gbps

key_facts.fact: Kandou argues its copper approach matches optical interconnect performance at 10x lower system cost versus competitors like Ayar Labs and Celestial AI
key_facts.excerpt: Competes against optical interconnect approaches (Ayar Labs, Celestial AI) by arguing copper can match performance at 10x lower system cost

key_facts.fact: The company is based in Lausanne, Switzerland, and uses an IP licensing model similar to Arm rather than manufacturing chips itself
key_facts.excerpt: Business model: IP licensing (similar to Arm), not chip manufacturing; headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland

sources.title: Kandou AI raises $225M to replace optical interconnects with enhanced copper for AI data centers
